title: Notifications Send Even When the User Opted Out
description:
`should_send(prefs, channel)` in `notifier.py` should check the user's per-channel opt-in flags from `preferences.py` and return `True` only if that channel is enabled. Right now it sends notifications on channels the user explicitly disabled. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`preferences.py` — `NotificationPreferences` stores per-channel `True`/`False` flags
`notifier.py` — decides whether to send on a given channel

**Function signature**
`should_send(prefs: NotificationPreferences, channel: str) -> bool`
